environment: macOS (Darwin 25.6.0), Python 3.14.7, Node v24.19.0, git 2.50.1; branches.py run by testkit cli-runner in a scratch git repo with TZ=UTC; Python API through python3 -I

cases.title: The acceptance verify name holds as the attack baseline
cases.given: a scratch git repo with sdlc/S-001
cases.then: exit 0, one JSON line, branch sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0
cases.expected: exit 0, one JSON line, branch sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0

evidence.title: The acceptance verify name holds as the attack baseline
evidence.inline:
input: name --kind verify --id S-001 --round 0 --profile http-api --part 0
observed: sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0, exit 0, tree unchanged

evidence.title: no side effect
evidence.inline: cli-runner tree diff of the scratch repo (files and refs) is empty for every call (treeUnchanged asserted per call); stderr is empty for every call

cases.title: Each missing or empty verify part exits 2 with one JSON error that names the part
cases.when: omit, or give as empty, each of --id, --round, --profile, --part; call tail('verify') with None and '' for each part
cases.then: exit 2, one JSON error naming the part, no traceback, no ref; tail raises Fail naming the part; round 0 and part 0 are kept
cases.expected: exit 2, one JSON error naming the part, no traceback, no ref; tail raises Fail naming the part; round 0 and part 0 are kept
cases.actual: 8 of 8 CLI calls exit 2 and name the part (empty --round and --part are refused by argparse with 'argument --round: invalid int value'); 8 of 8 API calls raise Fail naming the part; tail with round 0 and part 0 gives S-001-v0-http-api-0

cases.title: Malformed --round and --part exit 2 or give an ASCII integer, never a crash
cases.when: give 75 hostile values to --round and to --part (integer-forms, unicode-digits, huge-integers, unicode-whitespace, flag-like-values, injection, -1, 1.5, 0x1, ' 1', abc)
cases.then: each call exits 0 with an ASCII integer in the name, or exits 2 with one JSON error; no traceback, no stderr, no tree change
cases.expected: each call exits 0 with an ASCII integer in the name, or exits 2 with one JSON error; no traceback, no stderr, no tree change
cases.actual: 150 calls: 102 exit 2, 48 exit 0. Every exit 0 holds an ASCII integer. Accepted forms include -1, +1, 1_000, padded, unicode digits and 4300 digits (argparse int). No crash

evidence.title: Malformed --round and --part exit 2 or give an ASCII integer, never a crash

cases.title: Hostile --id and --profile never crash, never change state, and are used verbatim behind the sdlc/ prefix
cases.when: give each of 125 argv-safe corpus values to --id and to --profile
cases.then: exit 0 with sdlc/<id>-v0-<profile>-0 verbatim, or exit 2; one JSON line; no tree change
cases.expected: exit 0 with sdlc/<id>-v0-<profile>-0 verbatim, or exit 2; one JSON line; no tree change
cases.actual: 250 calls, all clean. Every exit 0 is the verbatim tail behind sdlc/. 73 ok names fail git check-ref-format (control chars, '..', '@{', spaces): no requirement for this kind asks name to check the full ref, so this is a known seed, not a failure
cases.specSource: VS-4 notes; seed already in barraiser.json (name does not run git check-ref-format on the full name)

cases.title: Abbreviated, duplicated and equals-form flags resolve to one flag or exit 2
